study.name: Exploratory Study – Example
study.description:
Exploratory study

An open, exploratory session in which a single group of participants interacts with one prototype. There is no comparison group; the goal is to observe behaviour and gather qualitative and quantitative feedback.

Replace the survey and prototype URLs below with your own.
study.consent:
Consent

Participation is voluntary and you may stop at any time. Your interaction data and questionnaire responses are collected and stored pseudonymously and used for research purposes only.

By continuing you confirm that you are at least 18 years old and agree to take part.

text.title: Welcome
text.body:
Welcome

Thank you for taking part. In this session you will explore a prototype and answer a few short questionnaires. Please think aloud as you go.

text.title: Thank you
text.body:
Thank you

That's the end of the session. Thank you for your time and feedback!
